text: For an electric dipole oscillating at angular frequency ω with fixed amplitude p₀, the time-averaged radiated power scales with frequency as:
explanation: The dipole power P = μ₀ω⁴p₀²/(12πc) scales as ω⁴ because the power is proportional to the square of the second time derivative of p, and each time derivative brings a factor ω. This ω⁴ law is exactly Rayleigh scattering, explaining why the sky is blue. The ω⁶ scaling instead belongs to electric quadrupole radiation (third time derivative of Q).
